phase2_sites.proposition: Carriage: SOLAS V/19.2.12 (MSC.532(107), in force 1 January 2026) for containerships and bulk carriers of 3,000 GT and upwards constructed on or after 1 January 2026, 'or other means'; MSC.363(92) is the performance standard (a recommendation, installed on or after 1 July 2015), minimum accuracy 5% of reading or +/-1 degree / +/-1 s, whichever is greater; not 'Regulation 20'.

SOLAS II-2/10.7.3 (MSC.365(93), adopted 22 May 2014) applies to ships constructed on or after 1 January 2016 designed to carry containers on or above the weather deck: at least one water mist lance; with five or more tiers, at least two (breadth < 30 m) or four (breadth >= 30 m) mobile water monitors. Not a recent or Li-ion-driven revision.
